# netframe-live-dashboard-feed/v1

The transport contract between **netframe-enterprise-assessment** (producer) and
**netframe-dashboard** (consumer). Two repositories, no shared code, so the only thing they can
share is a shape and a pinned example of it.

## Pinned fixture

`netframe-live-dashboard-feed-v1.json`

    sha256  d34730ff9628235e1578e0783a5038e62e079abe4f4291b0dc5c6bcfae1f5aca

The dashboard repository carries a byte-identical copy at
`tests/fixtures/netframe-live-dashboard-feed-v1.json` and asserts this digest. Neither side
clones the other and CI needs no network: changing the contract means changing both copies
deliberately, and a one-sided change fails on the side that was not updated.

The fixture is **generated by the producer's own model**, not written by hand
(`build_fixture.py`). A hand-written example drifts silently; a generated one cannot, because
the enterprise suite regenerates it into a temporary path and compares.

## Envelope

| field | meaning |
|---|---|
| `schema` | `netframe-live-dashboard-feed/v1`. An unrecognised value must fail toward UNSUPPORTED, never toward best-effort interpretation. |
| `generated_at` | when THIS producer cycle ran. The transport's own age. |
| `status` | `OK` \| `NO_SELECTION` \| `PRODUCER_FAILED`. |
| `selection` | `{incident_id, selected_at, selected_by}` or `null`. Display state, never lifecycle. |
| `state` | a `netframe-live-incident/v1` object, or `null`. |
| `state_generated_at` | when the carried `state` was produced. **Not** re-stamped when a cycle fails, so a carried projection keeps ageing. |
| `error` | producer error text when `PRODUCER_FAILED`, else `null`. |

The consumer adds one status of its own, `FEED_UNAVAILABLE`, when it cannot obtain an envelope
at all. That is a transport fact and is never confused with `NO_SELECTION`.

## Rules the consumer must honour

1. **Outer age wins.** If `generated_at` (or `state_generated_at` for a carried projection) is
   older than the bound, the panel is STALE regardless of any `FRESH` inside `state`. Those
   values were only fresh when the projection was made.
2. **`NO_SELECTION` is not health.** It means no operator selected an incident for this surface.
   Never render ALL CLEAR, NO INCIDENTS or HEALTHY.
3. **`PRODUCER_FAILED` is not "no incident".** Show the carried projection as LAST KNOWN with its
   own age, or say the feed failed. Never blank it to a clean state.
4. **No reinterpretation.** The consumer renders `state`. It does not threshold metrics,
   correlate, or derive an assessment. One measured fact, two presentations, one interpretation.
5. **`OPEN_NO_CURRENT_SIGNAL` is not green**, and `RECOVERY_SIGNALS` is not `RESOLVED`.
6. **Escape everything.** `state` carries operator-authored text.
7. **`authority.max_auto_class` is 0** and is displayed, not summarised away.
